QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Piercing Defenses
QuestInfo.0: The Knight Stronghold has tightened security. How will you find a way through? Talk to #bChief Alex#k in #bHenesys Ruins#k.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Alex said it will be possible to enter by posing as a knight. Defeat the knight guarding the #bStronghold Entrance#k and steal their #bKnight Emblem#k.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained the emblem to enter the stronghold. You won't get caught if you're wearing the pin.

0.0: You will need to infiltrate the Knight Stronghold to scout the Cygnus Knights' movements, but due to their strict security, you can't get in the usual way.

yes.0: Entering the stronghold is a cinch if you're wearing a Knight Emblem pin. Put it on and you've got an instant knight disguise.
yes.1: Of course, you'll have to defeat a knight to get one. It's no easy feat, but not impossible.
yes.2: Defeat the knights in the #bStronghold Entrance#k and steal the #b#t4032922##k.

no.0: Come back if you change your mind.

0.1: However, if we #btry something tricky#k... we might just have a chance. In fact, an old method we had may fit the bill. Want to give it a go?

1.0: Did you get the #b#t4032922##k? Pin it on your clothes where it's visible.

item.0: You can get a #bCygnus Knight Emblem#k by defeating one of the knights at the #bStronghold Entrance#k.
